Subject: Request: technical deep-dive / inference architecture review

Hi David —

Thanks again for the 20-minute intro last week. The engineering team at Acme would like a deeper walkthrough of Redwood's inference architecture and our specific integration pattern. We're looking for a ~75–90 minute session that includes:
- high-level architecture walkthrough (15–20m)
- dedicated capacity/latency characteristics (20m)
- deployment/region/fallback behavior (15m)
- Q&A and next steps (20m)

Can you propose 2–3 slots next week? Our team is West Coast (PST) but Tom might be in EST that week. We'll likely have 6 attendees (mix of infra and product).

Also: we need the session recorded and slides shared after the call. For compliance reasons we prefer the Zoom recording stored in our tenant, but we can accept an alternate recording location if needed.

Thanks —
Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Head of Platform, Acme AI

Hi Sarah —

Great — we'd be happy to run this. Proposed windows (all PST):
- Tue 2026-05-12 10:00–11:30 (best for our infra leads)
- Wed 2026-05-13 13:00–14:30 (if Tom needs later)

We'll target 90 minutes. Attendees from Redwood: myself, Marcus (serving runtime lead), and Laura (solutions engineer).

Logistics: we normally use a Zoom meeting for recording and local A/V if any Redwood folks join from HQ. If you prefer the recording in your tenant, we can (1) add an Acme recorder account to the Zoom invite, or (2) record and provide the file via a secure transfer. Which do you prefer?

I've attached a short draft agenda and capacity diagram for context. If those slots work I can send the calendar invite with the Zoom link.

—David
